title: Adobe Target JSON offer for a personalized section
description: Content of the JSON offer the Target user creates for a section's location (mbox). Delivered as a JSON offer (Delivery API) or a json-content-item proposition (Web SDK). A variant offer names a fragment; the control experience of an A/B test uses { "control": true } so it is reported as control, not as no-match. HTML offers are not supported. Extra fields are ignored.

fragment.description: Site-relative path of one of the section's listed variants.

control.description: Show the section's authored content on purpose (A/B control). Display and click are still sent to Target.
